name: Cocoa bean, fermented and dried (raw cocoa, ~7% moisture)
source: Fermented, sun-dried bean (the traded "raw cocoa" commodity): illustrative proximate (per kg) water 70 g (~7%), protein 128 g, fat 440 g, carbohydrate 320 g, ash 42 g — typical published cocoa-bean proximate ranges (cocoa science literature / USDA FoodData Central pattern for cacao).
notes: Standard elemental conversion factors as wheat-grain.json. Fermentation's real chemical changes (sugar consumption, acid formation) are folded into this file's dry-matter profile rather than modelled compound-by-compound; only the associated mass loss (pulp drainage, moisture, CO2) is tracked as an explicit balanced posting in origin/cocoa.ts — a stated simplification.
